documentLevelPrecision.rationale: Commercial plagiarism detection requires minimal false positives to prevent false accusations.

documentLevelRecall.rationale: Standard academic detection must reliably capture >=90% of copied or lightly modified passages.

falsePositiveRate.rationale: False positive rate on negative controls and original text must stay <= 5%.

sentenceSpanAccuracy.rationale: Text span coordinates into canonical text must have >=95% raw text slice match.

aiAdvisoryIsolation.rationale: Deterministic findings and scores must remain 100% bit-for-bit invariant under AI outages.
